pages.text: The next day, they rush back to the wood. "Do it again!" said Julia.
pages.picture: the next day: Julia and Toby running through the garden gate into the woods, excited

pages.text: Toby looks at the branch. It lifts and drifts and lands in her hand. Then a stick. Then a tin can.
pages.picture: in the clearing: the small leafy branch, a stick and a tin can drifting gently through the air into Julia's hands; Toby calm and focused, watching them

pages.text: "Now me," said Julia. She stands as still as a rock.
pages.picture: Julia standing very still with her eyes shut and her arms by her sides; Toby in front of her, calm and focused

pages.text: Toby looks at Julia. And then her feet lift off the grass.
pages.picture: Julia's red sneakers lifting off the grass, her face surprised; Toby calm and concentrating, gazing at her

pages.text: Up, up, up she floats! Higher than the gate. Higher than the play house.
pages.picture: high above the garden gate: Julia floating up, arms out; below, the backyard with the playhouse small in its corner, and the woods behind; Toby small at the gate, looking up

pages.text: "Whoa!" said Julia. "Toby, I am floating! I am floating up high!"
pages.picture: Julia high in the sky above the clearing, arms out, delighted, laughing; Toby far below, calm and focused

pages.text: Toby looks up at her, and she glides this way and that. She glides past the treetops, and the birds glide with her.
pages.picture: Julia gliding past the treetops with birds gliding beside her; Toby below in the clearing, looking up, calm, steering her with his gaze

pages.text: She loops the loop! She spins! She dips down to the pond and zooms back up!
pages.picture: Julia looping the loop in the air above the pond, shown once, with a curving trail of sparkles behind her to show the loop; Toby below by the pond, looking up

pages.text: "This is the best day!" Julia yells. "Again! Again!"
pages.picture: Julia laughing in mid-air, arms up, "Again!"; Toby below looking up at her with a small proud smile, still focused

pages.text: Far away, on top of Super-Tall Peak, it is dark. In a deep cave, a big black dragon wakes up.
pages.picture: far away on Super-Tall Peak: the huge black dragon lying in the deep dark cave, one eye opening, glowing red; cold moonlight at the cave mouth

pages.text: Its claws scrape the rock. Smoke curls from its nose.
pages.picture: close-up in the dark cave: the black dragon's huge claws scraping the rock, smoke curling from its nostrils

pages.text: "Toby," it hisses. "I can feel you. You can not hide from me."
pages.picture: the black dragon's narrow glowing red eyes in the darkness of the cave, looking straight out, menacing
